prompt:
Rewrite snippets/warehouse-availability.liquid so it renders stock availability per warehouse. The data comes from an import that leaves stray whitespace (spaces, tabs, newlines) around values, so values must be trimmed. Inputs (both top-level variables, no section.settings): - `heading`: string or null. - `warehouses`: an array (never null, possibly empty). Each element is an object with these keys, all always present: - `name`: string, never null, may be padded or whitespace-only. - `city`: string or null, may be padded or whitespace-only. - `quantity`: integer, may be zero or negative. Trimming rules: - Trim leading and trailing whitespace from `heading`, `name` and `city`. This is what Liquid `strip` does. Internal whitespace is kept unchanged. - A warehouse whose trimmed name is empty is invisible: skip it entirely. - A trimmed city that is empty is treated the same as a null city. - A heading that is null or empty after trimming is treated as absent. Output (no whitespace or newlines between any tags): - If there are no visible warehouses (an empty array, or all names blank), output exactly `

Not available at any warehouse

` and nothing else. The heading is not shown in this case. - Otherwise, output `
`, then `

HEADING

` (only when the heading is present), then `
    `, then one `
  • ` per visible warehouse in input order, then `
`. - Each item is `
  • NAME, CITY: STATUS
    • `. When there is no city, the `, CITY` part is omitted, giving `
  • NAME: STATUS
    • `. CLASS and STATUS depend on `quantity`: - quantity <= 0: class `out`, status `Out of stock`. - 1 to 5 inclusive: class `low`, status `Only N left`, where N is the quantity. - greater than 5: class `in`, status `In stock`. The trimmed heading, name and city are HTML-escaped with `escape`. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/warehouse-availability.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
